name: M3_CRS420MI_LstFreeText
description: List the user-defined free-text lines connected to a specific application message. The free-text block corresponds to what is shown when pressing F6 in the application message details panel (CRS420/E). Each returned record contains the company, the unique mail id, an internal line number, and a text segment of up to 60 characters, representing the stored user comments or notes.

inputParameters.name: MLID
inputParameters.description: Unique mail ID identifying the application message whose free text should be listed.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for the application message.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the application message.

outputParameters.name: MLID
outputParameters.description: Unique mail ID of the application message.

outputParameters.name: LINO
outputParameters.description: Internal line number of the free-text line within the message.

outputParameters.name: TX60
outputParameters.description: User-defined free-text for this line of the application message.
